title: Unit 6 — APA-06: Battery Discharge
description: Use the embedded battery data to calculate electrical power and compare voltage and power in two stacked MATLAB plots. Add clear labels and legends, interpret the cutoff and final power results, then download your script and export your figure for Canvas.
note: All data are embedded in the starter. The data are synthetic and 3.20 V is an exercise cutoff. Run Tests provides feedback and never submits to Canvas.
